items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, Pop Foster's with them now and I think Muggsy Spang is with them now.

ctx.x: He was there last year, I heard him. Yeah, yeah, he's still with them, yeah.
Well, Pop Foster's with them now and I think Muggsy Spang is with them now.

Well, they're still holding now. You see, Doc had wanted a house band. Well, we couldn't take it over because we had, George had too many commitments that was taken to different places at the time that Doc wanted us there. Well, naturally he just gave it up and got oil, you know? And Ed had wrote to me and told me that Doc had wanted a house band and he wanted to use me on the drums. So Doc called me up along the distance and asked me if I would take it. He said, now, it's not anything definite. He said, but if…
